description: Drop `GET /v1/cameras/{id}/snapshot`. The spec declares the 200 body as `image/jpeg` (`type: string, format: binary`). The converter reads only JSON or `application/octet-stream` bodies, so the operation would generate an empty `{}` output and the REST protocol would decode the JPEG bytes as text. A method that returns corrupt data is worse than none. Source: the operation's `responses.200.content` in the published Protect 7.4.102 OpenAPI document.
